title: Geophysics MicroseismicBrief

stats.done_summary: Microseismic analysis complete. Identified 3 seismic events from 12 P-wave picks across 5 stations. Grid-search location algorithm with bounded constraints located all events at shallow depths. K-means clustering revealed 2 spatial groups: Events 0&1 cluster in southwest (~0.2km apart), Event 2 isolated in northeast. Generated 7 figures: station geometry, event map, depth cross-section, 3D distribution, cluster elbow, residuals, and inter-event distances. Report includes methodology, results, discussion of structural implications, and recommendations for future monitoring.
